title: Uniform bound on the Euclidean coefficient norm of a test form
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be any set and let ω ∈ 𝒟^k(U) (TestFormOn U k: a C^∞ k-form ω : ℝ^P → Λ^k with compact support and tsupport ω ⊆ U). Then there is a real number M ≥ 0 such that |ω(x)|_E ≤ M for every x ∈ ℝ^P, where |α|_E := covectorEuclideanNorm α = (Σ_{I strictly increasing} α(e_{I(1)}, …, e_{I(k)})²)^{1/2} is the Euclidean coefficient norm of a k-covector α.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (ω : TestFormOn U k), ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ≤ M
